plan.title: Create Single-Stage RFP from Open Asset PR

steps.note: Provide the mandatory event title required for publishing.
Invite the two vendors named by the case.
Commit the requested Start now and 30-minute schedule.
Assert that the RFP create screen does not show a pricing column.
Assert that publishing reached a real project page.
Assert that the In Progress PR list contains at least one row; the catalog cannot correlate it to this exact event number.
Return to the event created by this plan for its post-publish menu check.
Open the published event's Settings menu.
Assert that Recreate Order is greyed out for an event created from a PR.
